items.name: Green Girdle
items.lore: Green silk, worked with gold. Gawain wore one like it, and lived.

items.name: Green Chapel Ring
items.lore: A ring of holly-wood that stays green all winter.

items.name: Root-Bleeder's Knife-Ring
items.lore: From a sacrificer's knife. Elaine washed it in the stream.
